name: @bastani/atomic
description: Atomic coding agent CLI with read, bash, edit, write tools and session management

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build-codemode-worker.mjs && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs executable dist/cli.js dist/rpc-entry.js && bun run copy-assets
scripts.bundle:dev: bun build src/bun/cli.ts --target=bun --minify --external mupdf --define process.env.ATOMIC_BUNDLED_BUILD="'1'" --outfile dist-dev/cli.js && bun build src/extensions/codemode/worker.ts --target=bun --format=esm --outfile dist-dev/codemode-worker.js && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy ../../node_modules/quickjs-wasi/quickjs.wasm dist-dev/
scripts.build:binary: bun run clean && bun run build && bun build --target=bun --format=cjs --minify-syntax --external mupdf --external=*native-modifiers.js ./dist/bun/cli.js --outfile dist/app.js && bun build --target=bun --format=cjs --external mupdf ./src/utils/image-resize-worker.ts --outfile dist/image-resize-worker.js && bun run build:codemode-worker && bun build --compile --bytecode --format=cjs --external mupdf --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --no-compile-autoload-bunfig ./dist/bun/split-loader.js --outfile dist/atomic && bun run copy-binary-assets && bun run assert-binary-assets
scripts.build:codemode-worker: bun build --target=bun --format=esm ./src/extensions/codemode/worker.ts --outfile dist/codemode-worker.js && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy ../../node_modules/quickjs-wasi/quickjs.wasm dist/
scripts.copy-assets: node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json dist/modes/interactive/theme/ && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy src/modes/interactive/assets/*.png dist/modes/interactive/assets/ && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy src/core/export-html/template.html src/core/export-html/template.css src/core/export-html/template.js dist/core/export-html/ && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js dist/core/export-html/vendor/ && bun run copy-builtin-packages
scripts.copy-binary-assets: node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy package.json dist/ && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy README.md dist/ && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy CHANGELOG.md dist/ && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy src/modes/interactive/theme/*.json dist/theme/ && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy src/modes/interactive/assets/*.png dist/assets/ && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy src/core/export-html/template.html src/core/export-html/template.css src/core/export-html/template.js dist/export-html/ && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy src/core/export-html/vendor/*.js dist/export-html/vendor/ && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy ../../node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-tui/dist/native-modifiers.js dist/ && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy ../../node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-tui/dist/native-module-path.js dist/ && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy ../../node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-tui/dist/native-platform.js dist/ && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy ../../node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-tui/native/win32/prebuilds/win32-* dist/native/win32/prebuilds/ && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy docs dist/ && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy examples dist/ && node ../../scripts/package-files.mjs copy ../../node_modules/@silvia-odwyer/photon-node/photon_rs_bg.wasm dist/ && bun run copy-builtin-packages
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build && bun run shrinkwrap

author: Mario Zechner
